statement: A one-page, phone-friendly website for Brew Lab, a specialty coffee shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, showing the menu with prices, opening hours, location and contact details, and letting visitors pre-order for pickup with no online payment. Target: 30 pre-orders per week.
audience: Coffee lovers and office staff near Indiranagar, Bengaluru
standards: One page only, plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file
Readable and usable on phones (360px wide) and desktop (1280px wide)
All shop facts shown exactly as given, none invented
rules: No online payment of any kind; customers pay at pickup
Pre-order form collects name, phone, items and pickup time and sends the order to hello@brewlab.example
No facts beyond those supplied by the Requester
done_when: The page shows the name Brew Lab and the address 12, 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038
The menu lists all seven items with their prices in rupees: Filter coffee 90, Cappuccino 160, Latte 180, Cold brew 200, Masala chai 80, Almond croissant 140, Banana bread slice 120
The opening hours show Monday to Saturday 7:30 am to 9:00 pm and Sunday 8:30 am to 6:00 pm
The phone +91 98450 12345 and the email hello@brewlab.example are shown
A pre-order form has name, phone, items and pickup time fields, sends the order to hello@brewlab.example, works when submitted, and states that payment is at pickup with no payment fields
A map or map link for the shop location is on the page next to the address
The file is a single page with a mobile viewport setting and has no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
